sentences.text: The Pradhan Mantri Skill Development Scheme (PMKVY) is an initiative by the Government of India.
It aims to enhance the employability of youth by providing skill development training.
The objective is to promote skill development in various sectors to meet the demands of the economy.
Benefits include financial assistance for training providers and skill training for individuals.
Eligible candidates are youth aged between 15 to 45 years.
The application process involves registration on the PMKVY portal.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
Training is conducted through affiliated training centers across the country.
The scheme is ongoing with periodic assessments and updates.
Additional details include a focus on both short-term and long-term skill development programs.
The scheme also emphasizes recognition of prior learning for those with existing skills.
